summary: First end-to-end test of BLOODHOUND Command Center. All 19 backend pytest cases pass (health, config, list filters incl. source/status/priority_band/daily_mission/min_score/q, summary, missions grouping w/ Won/Lost/Disqualified excluded, pipeline 9 stages, top/recent, get by id + 404, PATCH status, PATCH mission, POST activity — with activity_timeline verification). Frontend flows verified on external URL: Command Center metric strip renders live counts (new=1, immediate=4, ready=4, research=2, pipeline=$1.50M), Immediate Action card navigates to /opportunities?daily_mission=Call+Today, Status Pipeline stage click navigates to /opportunities?status=Ready, Opportunities search 'chartres' returns Marigny Shotgun, min-score slider present, view-grid toggle works, Opportunity Detail opp_004 shows score 96 + Band A + Ready badge, action-Conversation started button updates status successfully, Missions page renders all 9 mission-section-* groups, Relationships/Intelligence/Settings render without errors, Mobile 390x844 shows bottom-nav w/ 5 items and hides sidebar. Zero console 'error' logs across all pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Service singleton is process-local and mutable — PATCH endpoints persist only for the life of the backend process; documented but worth noting once Airtable is enabled (writes need to hit Airtable, not just in-memory copy).

AirtableOpportunityService is only a stub — currently inherits SampleOpportunityService and still returns sample data even when env is configured; add a clear log/warning if AIRTABLE_ENABLED=true but pyairtable client is not wired yet.
server.py has no /api-level exception handler; unexpected errors will return default FastAPI 500 without structured payload. Consider a global handler for consistent error shape.
seed_data_creation: None — sample data (15 opps) is baked into backend/data/sample_opportunities.py. Note: PATCH tests mutate in-memory service state (opp_003 status, opp_005 mission, opp_001 activity_timeline); a backend restart will reset them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (19 tests, all green). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend Playwright checks covered Command Center, Opportunities filters/search/view toggle, Opportunity Detail action buttons, Missions grid, placeholder pages, and mobile bottom-nav. No auth. All data-testids listed in review request were found and functional.
